title: DiSPlace - transistor-level placement with diffusion-sharing optimization
problem: Transistor-level placement directly impacts chip area, power consumption, and timing. Traditional placement algorithms do not optimize for diffusion-sharing opportunities at the transistor level.
motivation: Diffusion sharing between adjacent transistors can significantly reduce area and improve performance by eliminating redundant components and reducing parasitic capacitances.
method: DiSPlace performs transistor-level placement incorporating diffusion-sharing constraints, using optimization algorithms to identify and merge adjacent diffusion regions while maintaining electrical correctness and timing.
key_novelty: Integration of diffusion-sharing optimization into transistor-level placement, achieving simultaneous area and wirelength improvements.
contributions: Transistor-level placement algorithm with diffusion-sharing awareness
24% area savings through diffusion region consolidation
limitations: The approach is specific to transistor-level placement and may not scale efficiently to very large designs or account for manufacturing variability constraints.
